annotations.title: Every saved version of a file

description: Every version of one file the registry has saved, newest first: label, date, grade and the sha256 of its exact bytes. Versions are kept by content hash, so a file that later changes or disappears on GitHub still has its history here.

ref.description: owner/repo/name for a skill (anthropics/skills/pdf), owner/repo/path for any other file (vercel/next.js/AGENTS.md), or an art_ id from find_files.
